Would you like to spend your free time doing more work in school than you usually do?. I think a lot of kids would be against the idea of having to stay after school for homework club. If you do to much work you might overwork yourself and that wouldn't be good for your health. There are many examples, that show overworking could make you stressed or get headache. That is why I desagree that they should start an afterschool homework club.

One of the many reasons, is you need free time after a long day of school. A lot of kids can get frustated and angry if, they didn't get much free time. An example, would be sleeping in class because, a lot of students

like to take naps afterschool but, they wouldn't be able to if they had to stay afterschool. Another example, is that they wouldn't want to come to school and that may be because, of to much work. There would also be to much hours of having to stay in school like, doing

exams, test, quizzes, or class work.

there are also many students that have partime jobs. Having afterschool homework club would cause problems if they have to work. Not all students get free time like others, maybe they want to earn money but, they wouldn't be able to if they add a afterschool club. An example, would be if you work around 3:00pm, you wouldn't be able to work because, clubs can be an hour and a half long and usually middle schools end at around 2:30. That is why having afterschools clubs could affect some students.

my final reason, is teachers and students feel tired after a hole day of school. In my opinion they shouldn't add more hours to school, that way they have more time to rest and not worried about school work. Teachers can

get stressed because, of students behaviors. An example, would be students not listening to the teacher, that might make the teachers want to go home early. Even students can get stressed by teachers, it can be because, teachers yell to much and students can get headache for that. That's why students and also teachers would like to have more time to rest.

In conclution, they shouldn't add an afterschool homework club because, all students and teachers have other stuff to do that don't envolve school. Having to many hours of school can cause them to have stress and headache for having to do a lot of homework. Also a lot of students have partime jobs so, they wouln't stay after school. Finally, they have other activities to do and they wouldn't make them, if they have to go to the clubs. Remember students deserve their free time and teachers too, so do you agree with me?.

essays.text:
Dear Principle,

If our school were to change the cafeteria food to healthier food selections it would be a bad idea. This decision would be a bad idea because some students do not eat lunch as it is, other students say that the cafeteria food is already healthy, others would leave campus or order food online. Some schools in other school districts have changed their school menu and many students and parents do not like it nor agree with it.

Students do not eat lunch now a days because they do not like the food. Some rather just go to the snack bar or vending machine we have in the cafeteria and eat snacks rather than food or bring their own lunch to school. Students bring their own food most of the time because they are used to different foods or they are allergic to certain types of foods or ingredients.

Others may say that the cafeteria food is already healthy. In the cafeteria there are many options in the four different lines. For example one line can have three main foods with different sides including fruits and vegetables. The school line also has an option between the three main foods they are serving or a salad or wrap. When the school cafeteria serves bread or any type of carbs it usually is always wheat bread which is better than any other bread.

Students who have cars or credit cards often leave school to get food or they order food online. Upperclassmen, juniors and seniors are often the ones who leave campus to get food because they have there license and have cars or they also have friends who have transportation. They usually do not come back for their last periods of the day or if they come back they come back late to class. Now with new technology and apps students order food through apps that deliver any type of food to you. Students often get in trouble by teachers and staff for it but do it anyway.

In conclusion these are some of the reasons why changing the school cafeteria lunch/menu to a healthier menu would be a bad idea. Students who do not like the school lunches already do not eat, they would leave campus and not come back or come back late. And if they change the school menu there would be more students willing to do the same thing.
